law: Frame zero is a full-bleed, cover-locked hero image. Generate no baked text. Composite typography afterwards.
master_prompt_suffix: lit by one warm gold light source #D4A148 against near-black #0A0B0E, about 80 percent deep shadow, subject upper-mid with clean negative space for type, thin gold rim light, restrained cyan only when clinically relevant, volumetric haze, hyperreal dark editorial, vertical 9:16, no text, no logos, premium museum lighting

concepts.name: VISCERAL GLOWING ANATOMY
concepts.subject_prompt: a semi-transparent human heart, lungs, spinal cord, or nerve tree glowing from within like embers under glass

concepts.name: UNCANNY SCALE
concepts.subject_prompt: a lone athletic human dwarfed by a colossal physiological structure, dramatic scale contrast

concepts.name: THE SINGLE HAUNTING OBJECT
concepts.subject_prompt: one hyperreal familiar object transformed into an anatomically meaningful impossible form

concepts.name: THE BODY UNDER THREAT
concepts.subject_prompt: a human body under visible physical stress, cracking, invaded, or dissolving, beautiful but not graphic

concepts.name: INVISIBLE MADE VISIBLE
concepts.subject_prompt: a human figure with an invisible physiological process visualized as controlled light, particles, or trace

concepts.name: BEFORE AFTER TENSION
concepts.subject_prompt: one human figure with a seamless visual tension between two physiological states, never a deceptive before-after

concepts.name: THE NUMBER MADE PHYSICAL
concepts.subject_prompt: a human beside a physical monolith representing the quantity, with the number composited later

concepts.name: THE CUTAWAY CROSS SECTION
concepts.subject_prompt: a clean premium anatomical cross-section showing the relevant tissue with one clear focal plane

concepts.name: ELEMENTAL BODY
concepts.subject_prompt: a human body fused with a material metaphor such as liquid metal or light, with no spiritual symbolism

concepts.name: THE CONFRONTATION GAZE
concepts.subject_prompt: an extreme close-up of a person in real effort, one eye or focal facial detail locking to camera

concepts.name: DISTORTION OF THE FAMILIAR
concepts.subject_prompt: an everyday fitness or health object behaving in an impossible but legible way

concepts.name: MACRO HYPERREAL DETAIL
concepts.subject_prompt: one tiny physiological detail enlarged until it becomes cinematic and clearly readable

cover_lock.motion_after_hold: slow 1.00 to 1.06 push, particles, one gold bloom pulse, optional focus pull
cover_lock.thumbnail_test: 150px center square crop must preserve one subject, one light, one question
